concept: KMS: customer managed key — key policy, rotation, cross-account
tests: Distinguishing KMS key types: only a customer managed key offers an editable key policy, rotation control, and cross-account access.
expected: A customer managed key with a key policy naming the other account as a principal (plus IAM permissions for the caller). Triggers: "custom key policy", "control rotation", "another account decrypt".
why_not: AWS managed (aws/s3) and AWS owned keys have no editable key policy and cannot be shared cross-account; with SSE-S3 the keys are fully held by S3, no control at all.
